# Stepflow Documentation

> Durable workflow orchestration for TypeScript

Stepflow is a self-hosted, framework-agnostic workflow orchestration system with pluggable storage backends, multiple trigger types, and real-time client SDKs.

## Documentation Index

- [Introduction](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs): Durable workflow orchestration for TypeScript
- [Cloudflare Workers Adapter](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/adapters/cloudflare): Use Stepflow with Cloudflare Workers
- [Express Adapter](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/adapters/express): Use Stepflow with Express
- [Fastify Adapter](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/adapters/fastify): Use Stepflow with Fastify
- [Hono Adapter](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/adapters/hono): Use Stepflow with Hono
- [Adapters Overview](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/adapters): Connect Stepflow to your favorite web framework
- [Next.js Adapter](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/adapters/nextjs): Use Stepflow with Next.js App Router
- [Nitric Adapter](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/adapters/nitric): Use Stepflow with Nitric
- [API Reference](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/api-reference): Complete HTTP API reference for Stepflow
- [Client SDKs](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/client): Overview of Stepflow client SDKs for TypeScript, React, and React Native
- [React Native Hooks](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/client/react-native): Documentation for the @stepflowjs/react-native SDK
- [React Hooks](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/client/react): Documentation for the @stepflowjs/react SDK
- [TypeScript Client](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/client/typescript): Documentation for the @stepflowjs/client TypeScript SDK
- [Workflow Context](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/core/context): The main interface for interacting with Stepflow workflows
- [Retries & Backoff](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/core/retries): Configure automatic retries and backoff strategies
- [Durable Sleep](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/core/sleep): Pause workflows for minutes, hours, or days
- [Steps](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/core/steps): Checkpointed step execution in Stepflow
- [Wait for Event](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/core/wait-for-event): Pause workflows until an external event occurs
- [Workflows](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/core/workflows): Define durable workflows with Stepflow
- [Core Concepts](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/getting-started/concepts): Understanding the key concepts in Stepflow
- [Installation](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/getting-started/installation): How to install Stepflow in your project
- [Quick Start](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/getting-started/quick-start): Get up and running with Stepflow in 5 minutes
- [Observability](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/observability): Comprehensive observability for Stepflow workflows
- [Logging](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/observability/logging): Structured logging with Stepflow
- [Metrics](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/observability/metrics): Collect and export performance metrics
- [Timeline](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/observability/timeline): Time-travel debugging with execution timelines
- [Tracing](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/observability/tracing): Distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry
- [Memory Storage](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/storage/memory): In-memory storage adapter for development and testing
- [MongoDB Storage](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/storage/mongodb): Document-based storage adapter with real-time Change Streams
- [MSSQL Storage](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/storage/mssql): Enterprise-grade storage adapter for Microsoft SQL Server
- [NATS Storage](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/storage/nats): High-performance durable storage using NATS JetStream and KV
- [Storage Overview](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/storage/overview): Pluggable storage adapters for Stepflow
- [PostgreSQL Storage](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/storage/postgres): Production-ready storage adapter with ACID guarantees
- [Redis Storage](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/storage/redis): High-performance storage adapter for high-throughput workflows
- [SQLite / Turso Storage](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/storage/sqlite): Lightweight local and edge-compatible distributed storage
- [Cron Trigger](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/triggers/cron): Schedule workflows with cron expressions and leader election
- [HTTP Trigger](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/triggers/http): Trigger workflows via standard HTTP requests
- [Triggers](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/triggers): Overview of Stepflow triggers
- [Kafka Trigger](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/triggers/kafka): Trigger workflows from Kafka topics
- [NATS Trigger](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/triggers/nats): Trigger workflows from NATS messages
- [PostgreSQL Trigger](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/triggers/postgres): Trigger workflows on database changes using LISTEN/NOTIFY
- [Stream Trigger](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/triggers/stream): Generic trigger for any async iterable
- [Webhook Trigger](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/triggers/webhook): Webhook trigger with provider presets and signature verification
- [WebSocket Trigger](https://stepflow-production.up.railway.app/docs/triggers/websocket): Trigger workflows from WebSocket messages
